name: shopify-kit
description: Shopify custom-app building blocks (OAuth install flow, verified and deduplicated webhooks incl. the three compliance topics, a cost-aware Admin GraphQL orders client, an integer-cent sales aggregator with a reconciliation harness) and a Liquid theme fixed with the real theme-check. Tested against a local mock Admin API and fixtures written from Shopify's public documentation; never run on Shopify.
